# laravelcloud Provider

Manage [Laravel Cloud](https://cloud.laravel.com) resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    laravelcloud = {
      source = "madewithlove/laravelcloud"
    }
  }
}

provider "laravelcloud" {
  # The API token can also be supplied via the LARAVEL_CLOUD_TOKEN environment
  # variable, which is the recommended approach for secrets.
  api_token = var.laravel_cloud_token
}

variable "laravel_cloud_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Laravel Cloud API token. May also be set via the `LARAVEL_CLOUD_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Laravel Cloud API. Defaults to `https://cloud.laravel.com/api`. May also be set via the `LARAVEL_CLOUD_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
